profile.headline: Software Engineer | PHP, MySQL, React, Typescript
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Developer specializing in Python, FastAPI/PyNest, React, and PostgreSQL. Also experienced working with Ruby on Rails, and AWS (S3 & Glue). I'm an advocate for quality assurance and have used TestRail and Zephyr Scale in previous roles.

I am currently working on a hiring agency back-end project using Python, PyNest, PostgreSQL, pgAdmin 4, and Docker. The project can be seen here: https://github.com/beckyrich/hrAgent/tree/develop

positions.title: QA/Integrations Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Python, AWS S3 & Glue, APIs
* Created and implemented entire QA process for Integrations team designing tests & executions, identifying bugs & reports, and managing quality issues using Jira Zephyr Scale
* Successfully made bi-weekly contributions to code base using Python, fixing errors found in CSV outputs from ETL jobs. Assisted in converting original code base to a more automated workflow.
* Collaborated with 4 point products to streamline client onboarding documents and ensure the correct data is collected for each point product and client need
positions.insights: Skills: Software Engineering Practices · Amazon S3 · API Development · AWS Glue · Technical Documentation · Python

positions.title: Jr Software Engineer/QA
positions.locationName: Charleston, South Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Technologies: Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, React, and TailwindCSS
* Triaging bugs and communicating status with Product Owner, Engineering Team, Designer, and Product Manager.
* Working tickets from small bug fixes to supporting the building of features
* Implements and works an in-depth multi-device and browser QA process. Decreased bugs in application by 50% within first 90 days
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Software Engineering Practices · Ruby on Rails · Quality Assurance · Tailwind CSS · Test Cases · Test Planning

positions.title: Recreation Therapist
positions.description:
• Federal Contractor- Goldbelt (2018-2021), AFSC (2016-2018)
• I design and implement adaptive reconditioning programs for wounded, ill, and injured soldiers. I help meet their medical and personal goals of wellness through adapting activities, giving them a better quality of life. And introduce them to non profit organizations and resources within their communities.
• Organize and run 10+ adaptive events weekly, connect with local community and nonprofits, meet and strategize wellness plans of 150 soldiers, maintain and manage over $250,000 of adaptive equipment, and collaborate with an interdisciplinary medical team. 
• Selected to travel to multiple DoD Warrior Games, Training Camps, and Regional Trials for 40-400 wounded, ill, and injured soldiers and veterans to participate in 12 adaptive sports.

positions.title: Military Adaptive Reconditioning Coordinator
positions.description:
• Federal Contractor- DCS
• Grew Adaptive Reconditioning Program from 1 to 20 new events offered weekly in three months.
• Planned a minimum of 20 weekly adaptive reconditioning events for over 200 Soldiers in Transition with the Adaptive Recondition Lead and Interdisciplinary Team.
• Provided adaptive sports instruction using a variety of modalities and methods for a variety of disabilities with a high degree of professional competency & efficiency to ensure quality customer experience.
• Demonstrates knowledge of various types of adaptive sports equipment, teaching methods and other adaptive sports skills. Ability to observe, evaluate and adjust equipment or instruction approach as appropriate
• Communicates clearly and appropriately with Senior Army Leadership, medical staff, and Service Member Cadre at weekly and monthly meetings the status of the Adaptive Reconditioning Program
• Coordinates the repairs of adaptive sports equipment with local vendors and communicates with Army Supply Staff to ensure the safety of participants.

positions.title: Team Lead of Veteran Livable
positions.description:
Technologies: HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap
• Team Lead of 2 individuals that participated in a 48-hour Virtual Hackathon sponsored by Fall In for Vets to create a project resourceful for Veterans.
•  Responsible for UI/UX including color scheme, fonts, front end libraries, and wireframe layout. Created a remote repository in Github for the project. Also coded the entire Front End with features including: Carousel, Header, Footer, Navbar, Text, Cards, Images, Buttons, and Forms. Also presented and demoed the project for 6 judges and over 40 attendees for competition.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer Student
positions.description:
•  JavaScript, Bootstrap, React, React Native, Node, Express, and MongoDB: 22-Week Full Stack Web and Mobile Development Bootcamp focusing on mobile first technologies and applications.
• Project 1- Fictional Cafe built with Bootstrap, designed and responsive for both mobile and desktop use. Responsible for wireframes, color scheme, fonts, and overall layout. Along with "Meet the Team" and "Retail" pages. 
• Project 2- Recreated Project built with Bootstrap and converted it to React, making this mobile friendly site a single page application. Created remote repository in Github and designed wireframes.
